notes:
1.3.0: notes, diary/annual report export, dated baselines, tab order

- Notes: dated diary entries (title, text, time, area, tags, link to a task or work package,
  files); shown under each day in Today and Month, a Notes view with search (More), and
  'note: ...' in the add bar. Synced and included in backups.
- Export diary or report (More, Notes view, Settings > Backup & export): any period (presets),
  completed tasks, routines done, notes and/or the master plan, area filter, baseline choice;
  day by day grouped by month, empty days skipped. Word (docx 9.7.1), PDF (pdfmake 0.3.11,
  loaded only when exporting) or Excel (Diary + Summary + plan sheets).
- Baselines: save many dated, named baselines (30 kept); pick one in the Plan view to compare;
  used by the Excel plan export and the report. The old single baseline is kept.
- History for reports: routines keep ~3 years of done days; repeating tasks log each completion.
- Tabs: Today, Week, Month, Plan.
